name: Direct Labor COGS Exposure
definition: Derived direct production-labor subset of booked labor COGS, reconciled through monthly inventory.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Support Labor COGS Exposure
definition: Derived support-labor subset of booked labor COGS, unchanged by the direct-labor parameter.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Labor Exposure Difference
formula: IF([Complete Month Context], [Labor COGS] - [Direct Labor COGS Exposure] - [Support Labor COGS Exposure])
definition: Aggregate labor less analytical parts; zero in every supported slice.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Revenue
definition: Static shipped units, unchanged discount percentages; proportional net-price change.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Manufacturing COGS
formula: IF([Complete Month Context], [Material COGS] * (1 + [Material Change %]) + [Inbound Freight COGS] * (1 + [Inbound Change %]) + [Labor COGS] + [Direct Labor COGS Exposure] * [Labor Change %] + [Energy COGS] * (1 + [Energy Change %]) + [Overhead COGS])
definition: Five recognized COGS components once; only direct labor changes, support and overhead fixed.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Outbound Freight
definition: Shipment distribution expense, excluded from manufacturing COGS.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Gross Profit
formula: IF([Complete Month Context], [Scenario Revenue] - [Scenario Manufacturing COGS])
definition: Hypothetical manufacturing gross profit.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Gross Margin %
definition: Hypothetical gross margin fraction.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Selling Expenses
formula: IF([Company Context Valid], [Fixed Selling Expenses] + [Variable Selling Expenses] * (1 + [Price Change %]))
definition: Fixed selling unchanged; revenue-variable selling follows price at fixed volume.
filter_behavior: Company Date-only; BLANK under Product/Customer/Line/Material/Supplier filters.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Operating Expenses
formula: IF([Company Context Valid], [Scenario Selling Expenses] + [Administrative Expenses])
definition: Selling plus administration, matching operating_expenses.csv; outbound and production losses remain separate.
filter_behavior: Company Date-only; BLANK under Product/Customer/Line/Material/Supplier filters.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Operating Profit
formula: IF([Company Context Valid], [Scenario Gross Profit] - [Scenario Outbound Freight] - [Scenario Operating Expenses] - [Separately Expensed Production Costs])
definition: Company OP with each deduction recognized once.
filter_behavior: Company Date-only; BLANK under Product/Customer/Line/Material/Supplier filters.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario Operating Margin %
formula: DIVIDE([Scenario Operating Profit], IF([Company Context Valid], [Scenario Revenue]))
definition: Hypothetical company margin fraction.
filter_behavior: Company Date-only; BLANK under Product/Customer/Line/Material/Supplier filters.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario GP Change
formula: IF([Complete Month Context], [Scenario Gross Profit] - [Gross Profit])
definition: Absolute gross profit change from unchanged baseline.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario GP Change %
definition: Relative GP change; zero base profit returns BLANK.
filter_behavior: Recognized sales context: complete months and Date/Product/Customer/Line.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.

name: Scenario OP Change
formula: IF([Company Context Valid], [Scenario Operating Profit] - [Operating Profit])
definition: Absolute OP change, guarded for company context.
filter_behavior: Company Date-only; BLANK under Product/Customer/Line/Material/Supplier filters.
validation_status: Static/reference verification only; DAX execution pending Desktop.
validation_method: Compare full-precision reference calculator outputs and supplied Desktop scenario matrix; round only final display.
